mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS noteId, d.title AS title, d.type AS type, LEFT(d.content, 100) AS content, k.name AS kbName, bh.browse_time AS browseTime FROM browse_history bh
INNER JOIN document d ON bh.doc_id = d.id INNER JOIN knowledge_base k ON d.kb_id = k.id WHERE
(bh.user_id = #{userId} AND #{userId} IS NOT NULL)
OR (bh.visitor_id = #{visitorId} AND #{visitorId} IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY bh.browse_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO browse_history(doc_id, user_id, browse_time) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{userId}, #{browseTime})
